name: robots/sea-bass__pyrobosim
title: PyRoboSim world simulator
intro: PyRoboSim world simulator, adapted from sea-bass/pyrobosim. It reads `world_state`; sets `inflation_radius`; runs `reset_world`, `open_location` and `close_location`. `reset_world`: reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
